issue_context.title: Move cursor hidden when mousing over crate (classic orders)
issue_context.body: The default pointer cursor overrides the standard move cursor.

review_comments: I know this is just copied, but what is the usecase of selecting allied actors that are covered by fog?
The idea here is that we know that allied actors will never be covered by fog, so we can replace the relatively expensive fog check with a relatively cheap is-ally check.
I suspect that is what leads to the weird "health bars under fog" bug that dead players can encounter.

Do we have an issue for that? I think this may be the first i've heard about it.

Dead players should have the same rules as specs wrt `world.RenderPlayer`, so i'm not sure it can be that simple.

Pretty sure I mentioned this on IRC, but I didn't put together a reproduction case yet, so there's probably no issue. This was also more of a general comment that the assumption that all allied actors are revealed is bogus. I don't think we need or should fix this here. (Except if it is really that easy.)
